integrity: A complete mathematical proof and standard-library finite verifier are included. The finite check covers only listed short lengths; all-length conclusions rely on the proof. Independent scientific audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The uniform formula holds only at dimension two over F2 or F3; the ten-coordinate F4 example shows the same weight-multiset formula fails at field order four, not that all q>=4 cases behave alike. No independently validated claim or general higher-dimension theorem is asserted. Older equivalent formulations cannot be excluded exhaustively.
title: Exact rank-two code distortion over binary and ternary fields, with a quaternary boundary
